extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 2f1511cfd365252cc44b83cbba1e2ead60b3e7046daa568d2549e5d7faeced35 before extraction.
The exact job identity is IRLML6401 from KEXIN, LCSC C382329. The datasheet also prints the alternate marking KRLML6401.
The supplied PDF is a six-page KEXIN datasheet; no revision identifier is printed, so the revision is recorded as not stated.
P-channel quantities printed with negative signs are represented as positive magnitudes in specs and curve quantities retain the negative-sign axis semantics.
Figures 1, 3, 5, 6, and 7 contain usable plotted electrical curves. Listed points are direct manual readings from visible traces and grid coordinates; no points were generated by interpolation.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, gFS, gate charge table limits, switching times, Qrr, maximum ratings, avalanche energy, thermal resistance, or SOA; those published values were not added outside schema.
